name: vayudoot-photographs
description: Real photographs, referenced by absolute path and NOT stored in this repository. Cases whose image is missing are skipped, so running this manifest on a machine that does not have them reports skips rather than failures. Point the paths at your own photographs and the cases become live; the committed manifest.json is what runs everywhere.

guards.why: These two cases are the only ones in the project that can distinguish a calibrated confidence from a constant, because they are the only real photographs. The instruction they are testing has to still be there.

cases.note: Chimneys behind the estate, going all morning
cases.why: An unambiguous photograph of industrial stacks in operation: the easy end of the classification task, and the case that says whether the model can be confident when confidence is warranted. The confidence ceiling is not 1.0 by accident — the plumes are white, which is as consistent with steam as with combustion product, and a photograph cannot tell you which.

cases.note: The road every morning this week
cases.why: The hard case, and the most informative one in the whole set. Heavy regional smog over a road full of traffic. Both vehicle_emission and unclear are defensible readings, so the classification check accepts either — what is being measured here is the confidence. Ambient haze does not establish its own source, and a model that answers vehicle_emission at 0.95 has confused a plausible cause with a demonstrated one. That is exactly the reasoning error the corroboration stage made with the wind bearing.
